New articles (all previously reported — see foundry-already-reported-do-not-redup):

    Foundry Canvas; Toolbox overview; Toolbox authentication; use a toolbox with a hosted agent
  Foundry IQ: private agentic retrieval tutorial + validation
  Models/APIs: tool search with the Azure OpenAI Responses API; Claude hosting comparison
  Observability: export hosted agent telemetry via OpenTelemetry; restrict access to sensitive content
    in traces
  Platform: Notification Center
Updated articles: hosted agents, tool catalog, managed MCP servers via connector namespaces,
  A2A outbound + incoming A2A endpoints, web search tool, Foundry IQ, Claude models, WebSocket mode,
  Realtime GA migration, Foundry Models endpoints, evaluate agents, traces-to-dataset, portal GA.

## WHERE THE FOUNDRY DELTA ACTUALLY CAME FROM THIS SCAN
Per the standing method (roll-up is a POINTER INDEX, then open individual pages), the productive
Microsoft surface this scan was **Microsoft Agent Framework** — a separate docs tree and release
stream that is NOT in sources.json and had never been read. It produced two HIGH findings:
**Agent Hooks** (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 interception contract) and **FIDES** (information-flow control).
See microsoft-agent-framework_changelog.txt.
Both doc pages carry updated_at **2026-08-25**; FIDES has ms.date **2026-06-23** and was missed for
two months.
